purpose: Add a formula-neutral 3D photon-lensing observation adapter whose observable type, projection geometry, relativistic normalization, map products, scores, and artifacts remain explicitly separate from massive-tracer rotation and velocity mappings.

axisConvention.constraint: the three declared axes are a permutation of [0,1,2]

requiredGeometryValues.distanceRatio: explicit positive D_ls/D_s; never inferred from redshift or cosmology
requiredGeometryValues.lensAngularDiameterDistanceM: explicit positive D_l used only to convert transverse physical grid spacing to angular spacing

optionalScoredChannels.deflection_arcsec: paired east/north deflection maps with positive arcsecond uncertainty maps
optionalScoredChannels.reduced_shear_dimensionless: paired reduced-shear component maps with positive dimensionless uncertainty maps

separationContract: circular_speed_curve and line_of_sight_velocity_field continue to reject photons-only observables
velocity, deflection, and reduced-shear residuals are aggregated only within their own named channel and unit
no scalar aggregate may combine residuals having different physical units
observation evaluation adds zero gravity parameters and never re-solves or mutates the field

acceptanceFixtures.purpose: freeze sign, 2/c^2 normalization, path-length scaling, and distance-ratio scaling
recover known convergence, both shear components, zero rotation, determinant, and magnification
recover 4GM/(c^2 b) away from the unresolved center
produce the same named north/east maps after permuting storage axes and vector components
score exact deflection and reduced-shear maps and preserve channel separation
integrated and standalone observation evaluations emit byte-identical lensing score and map artifacts

claimBoundary: P0734 validates the mapping from a submitted photon acceleration field to weak-lensing map observables; it does not validate the gravity equation that produced that field.
The fixed 2/c^2 projection is the declared weak-field zero-slip normalization for an acceleration-like photon observable, not a derivation of a covariant metric theory.
Convergence and reduced-shear map comparisons may depend on published reconstruction assumptions; provenance must identify those assumptions.
P0734 does not fit raw multiple-image positions, source positions, time delays, critical curves, or cosmological distances. Those require separately typed follow-on adapters.
A successful analytic or synthetic gate is numerical conformance, not evidence that a baryon-only theory explains cluster lensing.
